description: KPI catalog (build spec §16, screen 34): every KPI defined once, as data — 28 entries carrying definition, formula reference, source dataset, owner role, cadence and target band. The dataState envelope renders engine output honestly: OK, WITHHELD (R1 fail-closed money — mixed currencies null the money strip with a reason, an operational event, never a poisoned sum), INSUFFICIENT_DATA (R2 — nothing plannable renders 'insufficient plannable data', never a fabricated 100%), STALE (a seal older than the entry's explicit threshold renders stale, never silent — the freshness stamp itself is mandatory). The module never re-implements a formula: the portfolio strip maps the engine's verified canon into the envelope. INV-04's grain (the one historical text-vs-canon difference, disclosed on every result since D-020) is reconciled to the canon by spec Amendment A16; the result note records the reconciliation for audit. Version bumps per §16.8 governance: spec amendment + module version bump.
